definition: An item of organizational value that is managed across its IT lifecycle to deliver or support IT services.
rationale: Use this phrase for an item of organizational value managed through an IT lifecycle, including its purchase, use, and disposal context, to deliver or support IT services. An IT asset can also be represented as a configuration item, but this phrase emphasizes value, cost, risk, and lifecycle management rather than configuration attributes and relationships. Do not use it for an asset register or management tool, or for an approval authority.

allowed.text: The IT asset register records the laptop's owner, purchase date, and disposal status.
allowed.rationale: Names an item managed through an IT asset lifecycle and distinguishes it from the register that records it.

not_allowed.text: The IT asset approved the purchase of the replacement server.
not_allowed.rationale: Conflates the item of value with an authority that approves a purchase.
